items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: When I went and saw that man in that pool hall, man, he went up to me and put his arms around me.

ctx.x: Aw, "Come up to see me sometime." So what should happen, I see him in Seattle. He knows we're coming. He left word at the desk that Buck and Bubbles were coming in -- tell them where I am. And he was across the street in a pool hall, he's racking balls in a pool hall across from the hotel. When I went and saw that man in that pool hall, man, he went up to me and put his arms around me. I'm

wondering what for because I hadn't learned nothing that happened since then. He was so glad that I stopped him from doing what he did. He told me what happened. Told me that his mother got a home and how nice she had been to him. I don't need to say no more concerning how glad he is that he took my advice. That's what he got from my advice.
